  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  CITY COUNCIL

  REGULAR MEETING

  TUESDAY, AUGUST 11, 2020 AT 6:00 PM

CALL TO ORDER

The regular meeting of the City Council of the City of Hawaiian Gardens was called to
order by Mayor Jesse Alvarado on Wednesday, August 11, 2020, at 6:02 PM in the City
Council Chambers, 21815 Pioneer Boulevard, Hawaiian Gardens, California.

Lucie Colombo, CMC, City Clerk, provided brief information relating to the conduct of
the virtual video meeting due to the COVID-19 pandemic situation, as listed on the
agenda.

INVOCATION
Lucie Colombo led the invocation.
FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Mayor Pro Tem Roa.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT
  MAYOR  JESSE ALVARADO
  MAYOR PRO TEM  LUIS ROA
  COUNCILMEMBER  VICTOR FARFAN
  COUNCILMEMBER  MYRA MARAVILLA
  COUNCILMEMBER  HANK TRIMBLE

Lucie Colombo, CMC, CPMC, announced a quorum.

The City Clerk provided information relating to the conduct of the General Public
Comment and Public Hearing Public Comment sections to follow for the virtual video
conference meeting as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic situation.

PROCLAMATIONS AND CERTIFICATES

There were no Proclamations and Certificates at this time.

PRESENTATIONS

Video presentation of the Curbside Cleanup.

A.  PUBLIC HEARING(S) / HEARING(S)

B.  CONSENT CALENDAR
Items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one
motion and one vote. There will be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion
is desired, that item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and will be considered
separately.

The City Council, upon approval of the Consent Calendar will waive reading in full of all
ordinances and resolutions on the agenda and declare that said titles which appear on
the public agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further reading
waived.

7.  RESOLUTION NO. 067-2020
  APPROVE AN AMENDMENT TO THE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF
  HAWAIIAN GARDENS AND THE SOUTHEAST LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT BOARD (SELACO) TO CONDUCT A FY 2020-
  2021 “EARN AND LEARN” WORK EXPERIENCE PROGRAM FROM JULY TO
  DECEMBER 2020 AND TO AMEND THE 2019-2021 CITYWIDE BUDGET TO
  INCLUDE THESE FUNDS.

Councilmember Trimble spoke.

Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director, spoke.

The City Manager spoke.

It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Roa and
approved by roll call vote as follows to approve Resolution 067-2020.

AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
NOES:  NONE
ABSTAIN:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carried, 5-0.

Items.
14.  PROJECT PROPOSAL FOR A TECHNOLOGY CENTER TO BE ESTABLISHED
  AT A HAWAIIAN GARDENS FACILITY.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Approve the proposed agreement.

The City Manager spoke.

David Marquez, Executive Director of Parent Engagement Institute, spoke.

All City Council members spoke.

It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, and
approved by roll call vote as follows to develop a contract for a one-year term and bring
Agenda Item back to the next City Council meeting.

AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, ROA, ALVARADO
NOES:  TRIMBLE
ABSTAIN:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carried, 4-0-1. Councilmember Trimble opposed.

  APPROVING COVID-19 SMALL BUSINESS RELIEF PROGRAM GUIDELINES
  FOR THE CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Adopt Resolution No. 070-2020.

Joe Colombo, Community and Development Director, presented the staff report.

The City Manager spoke.

All City Councilmembers spoke.

It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla, seconded by Councilmember Farfan and
approved by roll call vote to adopt Resolution No. 070-2020.
AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
NOES:  NONE
ABSTAIN:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carried, 5-0.
11.  RESOLUTION NO. 071-2020
  APPROVING COVID-19 EMERGENCY RESIDENTIAL RENTAL ASSISTANCE
  PROGRAM GUIDELINES FOR THE CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS.

  COUNCIL ACTION:  Adopt Resolution No. 071-2020.

Joe Colombo, Community and Development Director, presented the staff report.

The City Manager spoke.

All City Councilmembers spoke.

It was moved by Councilmember Maravilla, seconded by Councilmember Farfan, and
approved by roll call vote as follows to amend the staff recommendation to max of
$1000 a month to two months and change the bracket to low income ($56,300) and
below, and immediately start this program with COVID-19 monies, and put this Agenda
Item on the next Public Housing Authority meeting.

AYES:  FARFAN, MARAVILLA, TRIMBLE, ROA, ALVARADO
NOES:  NONE
ABSTAIN:  NONE
ABSENT:  NONE

Motion carried, 5-0.

12.  CONSIDERATION TO APPROVE LETTER OF SUPPORT TO REOPEN THE
  GARDENS CASINO (CARD CLUB) FOR OUTDOOR GAMING.
  COUNCIL ACTION:  Approve letter of support.
